test_policy.notes: JSU is test-optional for freshman admission: ACT/SAT are not required and admission is based on high school GPA. International freshmen need a high school GPA of 2.0/4.0 (evaluated on the US scale). Scores can still help with placement, some programs and merit scholarship upgrades (test scores can only raise a scholarship, not lower it).

requirements.notes: International freshmen apply on JSU's own application: $50 non-refundable fee (the Bursar fee table lists $35; the international admissions page and FAQ say $50). Documents: international high school records showing a 2.0/4.0 GPA (translated if not in English), passport copy, English proficiency proof unless from an exempt country, and a financial statement (at least $38,300 effective spring 2027). Documents are uploaded to the application portal, not emailed; SAT/ACT/iTEP scores must come from the testing agency. An admitted student pays a $200 international application deposit before the I-20 is issued. Essays and recommendations are not mentioned.

deadlines.label: International application period closes (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Fall 2027 application period is Aug. 10, 2026 to June 1, 2027 (classes begin Aug. 18, 2027). Spring 2027 period is June 1 to Nov. 1, 2026. JSU offers no summer intake for undergraduate international students. No earlier priority date is printed for admission.

deadlines.label: Jones International House Program application deadline (priority March 1)
deadlines.notes: Program gives a tuition and fees scholarship plus a housing scholarship for up to 2 years. The page prints March 1 (priority) and April 1 without a year; treated as 2027. Applicant must already have a JSU ID and be admitted; undergraduate international applicants need a 2.5/4.0 high school GPA.

deadlines.label: Test scores due for freshman merit-scholarship upgrades (fall admits)
deadlines.notes: Merit scholarships are awarded automatically on admission from the highest cumulative high school GPA; scores received by May 1 can raise the award. Year not printed; treated as 2027.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Students from listed English-speaking countries (e.g. Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Nigeria, New Zealand, South Africa, United Kingdom) are exempt from the test requirement; transfers with 24+ credit hours from accredited US institutions may also be exempt. Alternatives to a test: completion of JSU's English Language Institute (ELI) Level 4, iTEP 3.7, ACT composite 18 (English 14+) or SAT composite 960. The page also prints a SAT Critical Reading minimum of 19, which looks like a typo and is not recorded. Scores must be sent from the testing agency.

english.notes: Undergraduate minimum for tests taken before 2026-01-21 (graduate: 79).
Undergraduate minimum for tests taken on or after 2026-01-21. The page lists 3.5 without naming the 1-6 scale.

cost.notes: Bursar page, 2026-2027 block tuition: 12-18 credit hours cost $5,400 per semester in-state and $10,800 per semester out-of-state and international, so the yearly figures are two semesters. Fees ($2,860) and room and board ($6,104 housing + $4,290 meals, on campus) are JSU's published average estimates; the in-state estimate lists $10,800 tuition. Other = miscellaneous $2,260; transportation estimate $2,106 not included. International student fee is $150 per semester. Total cost of attendance is not published for international students.

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for financial aid but can earn scholarships. Freshman merit awards are automatic on admission, based on high school GPA (2027-28: $1,000-$8,000 a year for GPA 2.00-4.0+, up to $10,500 with ACT 31+/SAT 1390+), last up to 8 semesters, and out-of-state students who receive one pay the remaining tuition at the in-state rate. The merit page does not explicitly address international applicants, but JSU's international FAQ lists it. The Jones International House Program offers a tuition-and-fees plus housing scholarship (up to 2 years). CDS H6 reports 329 nonresidents with institutional aid, average $10,022, although B2 counts only 231 nonresident undergraduates, so treat that figure with caution.

sat.note: The reviewed JSU pages do not print a numeric SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: The reviewed JSU pages do not print a numeric ACT code; look it up at act.org.
